title: Power-duration curve
description: All-time best rolling averages from mart.power_curve_best, logarithmic duration axis. The record date (mart.power_curve_best.local_date, derived from the activity that produced it) is visible in the table below the chart.

list.name: kind
list.query: bike_power : bike_power, run_power : run_power, run_speed : run_speed, swim_speed : swim_speed, heart_rate : heart_rate

panels.title: Record curve — $kind
panels.description: Best sustained value per duration (mart.power_curve_best), one row per (kind, duration_s), NOT merged across disciplines (COMMENT ON COLUMN mart.power_curve_best.kind: bike_power and run_power are not comparable). Duration axis (duration_s) on a logarithmic scale.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.duration_s AS "duration_s", c.value AS "value" FROM mart.power_curve_best c WHERE c.kind = '$kind' ORDER BY c.duration_s

panels.title: Detail — record and date
panels.description: mart.power_curve_best.local_date answers "which day did I set this record?" (COMMENT ON MATERIALIZED VIEW mart.power_curve_best).

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", c.value AS "Value", c.local_date AS "Record date", c.activity_id AS "Activity" FROM mart.power_curve_best c WHERE c.kind = '$kind' ORDER BY c.duration_s
